arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess,os,tempfile,shutil,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
target='martaxi-boss/Project-leader-codex'
base='4a5c5ba5876bad079ec4edf401416804c18bc521'
security='bf72b304922369cc193e99f6014b0253c0f8c0ba'
distribution='b9e523c2af213c61ee78e5634f17c13832980b38'
temp=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='rea-plcodex-two-prs-integration-',dir='/tmp'))
temp.chmod(0o700)
def git(src,*args):
 p=subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(src),*args],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=90)
 return p.stdout.strip()
try:
 src=temp/'candidate'
 subprocess.run(['git','clone','--quiet','--depth','35','--branch','main','https://github.com/'+target+'.git',str(src)],check=True,timeout=75,capture_output=True)
 assert git(src,'rev-parse','HEAD')==base,'MAIN_MOVED_STOP'
 print('REAL_BASE_SHA_VERIFIED',base,flush=True)
 git(src,'fetch','--no-tags','--depth=35','origin','refs/heads/fix/rea-codex-worker-env-20261030')
 assert git(src,'rev-parse','FETCH_HEAD')==security,'SECURITY_PR_DRIFT'
 git(src,'fetch','--no-tags','--depth=35','origin','refs/heads/fix/rea-plcodex-e3-distribution-20261030')
 assert git(src,'rev-parse','FETCH_HEAD')==distribution,'DISTRIBUTION_PR_DRIFT'
 git(src,'-c','user.name=REA Integration Test','-c','user.email=rea-integration@users.noreply.github.com','merge','--no-ff','--no-edit','--no-gpg-sign',security)
 git(src,'-c','user.name=REA Integration Test','-c','user.email=rea-integration@users.noreply.github.com','merge','--no-ff','--no-edit','--no-gpg-sign',distribution)
 assert git(src,'merge-base','--is-ancestor',security,'HEAD')==''
 assert git(src,'merge-base','--is-ancestor',distribution,'HEAD')==''
 expected={
 'codex/dual.py','codex/tests/test_worker_environment.py',
 'codex/agent_policy.py','codex/tests/test_agent_policy.py',
 '.agents/plugins/marketplace.json','.github/workflows/package-plugins.yml','README.md',
 'plugins/project-leader-codex/.app.json','plugins/project-leader-codex/plugin.json',
 'scripts/package_plugins.py','tests/test_audit_p1_regressions.py','tests/test_packaging.py',
 '.project-leader/tasks/PL-CODEX-PLUGIN-DISTRIBUTION-20261030.json',
 '.project-leader/results/PL-CODEX-PLUGIN-DISTRIBUTION-20261030.json'}
 changed=set(git(src,'diff','--name-only',base,'HEAD').splitlines())
 assert changed==expected,'UNEXPECTED_MERGED_PATHS '+str(sorted(changed^expected))
 print('EXACT_COMBINED_SCOPE_PASS',len(changed),'FILES',flush=True)
 git(src,'diff','--check',base,'HEAD')
 env=dict(os.environ)
 env['PYTHONPATH']=str(src)
 for label,dir_ in [('CONTROL','tests'),('CODEX','codex/tests')]:
  p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','unittest','discover','-s',dir_,'-p','test_*.py','-q'],cwd=src,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=140)
  txt=p.stdout+'\n'+p.stderr
  print(label+'_SUITE_EXIT',p.returncode,flush=True)
  summary=[l.strip() for l in txt.splitlines() if l.strip().startswith('Ran ') or l.strip()=='OK' or l.strip().startswith('FAILED ')]
  print(label+'_SUITE_RESULT','; '.join(summary[-4:]),flush=True)
  if p.returncode:print(label+'_FAIL_TAIL',txt[-1700:].replace('\n',' | '));raise RuntimeError(label+'_SUITE_FAILED')
 fromroot=temp/'package'
 fromroot.mkdir(mode=0o700)
 sys.path.insert(0,str(src))
 from scripts.package_plugins import build,sha256_file
 package=build(src,fromroot)
 assert package['provenance']['repository']==target
 names={p['name'] for p in package['plugins']}
 assert names=={'project-leader','project-leader-codex','recovery-guardian'}
 assert all(sha256_file(fromroot/e['file'])==e['sha256'] for e in package['plugins'])
 print('REPRODUCIBLE_PACKAGE_PASS',len(names),'plugins',flush=True)
 assert not git(src,'status','--porcelain'),'WORKTREE_DIRTY_AFTER_TESTS'
 print('COMBINED_PR44_PR45_INTEGRATION_PASS',flush=True)
 print('NO_MAIN_PUSH_NO_MERGE_TO_REMOTE_PASS',flush=True)
finally:
 shutil.rmtree(temp)
 print('INTEGRATION_PRIVATE_CLEANUP_PASS',flush=True)
PY
